newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGS-Thomson falls on H1, outlook.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomson falls on H1, outlook.

text.p: Shares in semiconductor group SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV fell on the Paris Bourse after the company reported its first half results and said it expected a flat gross margin in the third quarter.
At 0840 GMT, the share was down 2.57 percent at 401.50 francs.

SGS-Thomson reported a 48 percent drop in both its second quarter and first half results. The figures were in line with expectations because the company had warned the market in June that its second quarter would be in line with the first.
But recent better-than-expected results from Intel, Texas Instruments and Motorola had lifted high tech shares including SGS-Thomson and investors were awaiting a positive message.

"There were hopes that the company woud have said it saw a rise in margins in the third quarter. It did not, it said the third quarter would be flat and it saw a rise in the fourth quarter," a broker said.
